headline: Safety Score v8.0 folds in mint authority, report cards score chain and oracle risk, and a depeg control board ships.
fieldNotes: The week's spine was scoring: mint authority finally counts toward decentralization in Safety Score v8.0, and report cards learned to weigh chain and oracle risk, with each risk backed by on-chain verification rather than assertion. Around that, reserves and redemption gained real evidence, the depeg view became a working control board, and a long code-health pass folded duplicated helpers into shared foundations. Plenty shipped; most of it quietly load-bearing.

summary.label: Safety Score v8.0
summary.description: Mint authority joins the Decentralization factor as a penalty-only blend, backed by on-chain verification of the issuer registry. Caps now decay, multiple incidents are supported, and the score shows on coin pages.

summary.label: Chain & oracle risk
summary.description: Report cards now fold in L2BEAT chain risk and CDP oracle risk, with new bridge-route and enriched oracle risk profiles. The Decentralization compute is deduped and now enforces oracle coverage.

summary.label: Reserves & redemption
summary.description: Reserve views ship for 11 active coins, eight more become evidence-bearing attestation feeds, and 30 redemption routes gain live reserve-sync capacity. Redemption reaches v4.11 with documented same-day buffers.

summary.label: Yield & new coins
summary.description: Yield coverage expands via the Wave 1 source-roster (v8.23) and a wider coverage audit, and Royco eEARN and autoUSD join the tracked set with vault supply backfilled from chain.

summary.label: Depeg control board
summary.description: The depeg table becomes an interactive control board with filtering, sorting, and severity signals. Displayed deviation is now gated on peg-reference authority (DEWS v6.08), and repair-required events are quarantined.

summary.label: Verification passport
summary.description: The coin detail hero becomes a verification passport with visas for Issued, MiCA, GENIUS, and track record. The contract wall becomes labeled rows with inline verify actions. An MRZ experiment was reverted.

summary.label: Search, a11y & performance
summary.description: Per-chain OG cards ship for 107 chain pages, detail pages gain FAQ and Article JSON-LD, and a hydrated-state axe lane plus screen-reader tables raise accessibility. The CSP drops unsafe-eval.

summary.label: Platform consolidation
summary.description: Code-health Waves 1 to 4 dedupe helpers across worker, scripts, shared, and frontend layers, prune dead exports, name magic numbers, and tidy worker, redemption, and scoring internals.
